item.title: Dorchester County Earned CRS Rating, Providing Flood Insurance Savings for Homeowners
item.description: Dorchester County is proud to announce that the Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency, has awarded the County with its first Community Rating System (CRS) rating, which was a Class 8 Rating.

item.title: The Chainsmokers to Headline 2026 High Tide Music Festival in June
item.description: High Tide, a 21-and-older annual music and arts festival, announced today the lineup for its return to North Charleston’s Riverfront Park on June 5 and 6, 2026, including headliner The Chainsmokers.

item.title: Quintin’s Close-Ups: Pet of the Week (Reggie)
item.description: Quintin Washington of Quintin's Close-Ups recently spoke with Lynn Rosato with Hallie Hill Animal Sanctuary, who introduces us to the latest “Pet of the Week.”

item.title: The Black Keys to Perform at North Charleston's Firefly Distillery in July
item.description: The Black Keys announced today that they will bring their Peaches ’n Kream World Tour to the outdoor stage at Firefly Distillery on Thursday, July 30. They will be joined by guest Eddie 9V.

item.title: How to Choose the Right Cannabis Products for You
item.description: Cannabis choices can feel simple right up until you are standing in front of a menu and realizing you have to pick more than “sativa or indica.” There are formats, strengths, and label terms that sound familiar but do not always mean what people think. And if you are using cannabis for the first time in a while, it can be hard to tell what is “mild” versus “strong” in a way that actually matches your body.

item.title: South Carolina Is 2026’s 6th Worst State for Singles – WalletHub Study
item.description: WalletHub recently released its study on 2025's Best & Worst States for Singles and South Carolina ranked as the 9th WORST in the country. This is a slight fall for the Palmetto State, which ranked better last year.

item.title: How Careful Planning Creates a More Enjoyable Mountain Travel Experience
item.description: A great mountain trip starts long before you lace up your boots. The best days feel smooth because the big choices were made early, and the small choices have room to breathe. With a plan that fits your goals, the mountains feel bigger in the best way.

item.title: The Sweet Benefits and Uses of Artisan Honey
item.description: Honey has long stood as a natural sweetener and folk remedy, beloved for both its taste and purported healing properties. However, beyond the familiar jars lining supermarket shelves lies a world of artisan honey, which offers a richer tapestry of tastes and benefits. Sourced from independent beekeepers, these varieties provide not only flavor diversity but also enhanced health perks compared to their mass-produced counterparts.
